provenance_note: Teacher-supplied learner report. Difficulty codes describe learner gaps only and are not evidence for pronunciation, meaning, part of speech or CEFR.

difficulty_code_legend.1: pronunciation unknown; also used when no number was supplied

editorial_policy.candidate_only_rule: Candidate-only matches remain unapproved and contribute no lexical answer data to this archive.
editorial_policy.sense_rule: No source sentence was supplied; every item needs context confirmation before a sense-specific answer is authored.
editorial_policy.proper_noun_rule: Arctic, Antarctic and Pacific remain mixed/context-dependent until their source contexts confirm adjectival, common-word or proper-name use. Pacific retains the teacher-supplied display case.
editorial_policy.homograph_rule: A reported spelling may cover multiple senses, parts of speech, stress patterns or pronunciations. Without source context it is retained as one spelling-level learner report and remains pending sense confirmation rather than receiving an inferred answer.
